## v1.38.0

Adds a much wider `mgmt.doctor`, a guided fix, a timed probe, a doctor CLI, turn warnings and session diagnostics. Two outputs change shape and can break code that reads them, listed under Behavior change.

### Added

- `mgmt.doctor` checks agents, avatars, voices and languages, plus speed, tool-spiral and prompt mistakes. It has `only`, `skip`, `ignore`, `thresholds` and `concurrency` options, and a stable order. (#466, #467)
- `mgmt.doctorFix(ks, report, { apply, codes })` fixes `asr_language_mismatch`. Dry run by default, named codes to write, a fresh read of the agent and its intellect before each write, and an `undo` body. (#469)
- `mgmt.doctorProbe(ks, { agentId })` sends one text message and returns timings, tool segment count and the model settings in effect. Write. `timeoutMs` defaults to 60000. It does not run when active lifecycle rules match the agent unless you pass `allowSideEffects`. (#473)
- `npm run doctor` (`scripts/doctor.mjs`) runs the doctor from a terminal: `--fix`, `--fix --apply --code`, `--probe`, `--json`, `--fail-on`. (#470, #473)
- `KalturaAvatarSession` raises `warning` events `speech_not_started`, `slow_turn`, `tool_heavy_turn`, `config_language_differs` and `reply_language_differs_from_config`, and a `turnTimings` event per turn. (#468)
- `session.diagnostics()` and `formatDiagnostics()` give a content-free summary to paste into a ticket. (#472)
- `docs/DOCTOR.md` lists every finding code and starts from a symptom. (#471, #475)

### Changed

- A failed read of one intellect, tool or skill becomes a `read_failed` finding. The run goes on. (#466)

### Fixed

- `setForcedLanguage` keeps a non-default ASR provider. Before, it reset the provider to `kaltura`. (#465)
- `lifecycle.audit` counts in `checked` honor the `agentIds` filter. (#465)

### Behavior change

- A doctor finding about an intellect that several agents share has `agentIds`, not `agentId`. Read `agentIds` to find every agent. (#466)
- `mgmt.doctor` reports more codes than before. Code that fails on any finding can fail on new ones. Use `ignore` or `--fail-on error`. (#466, #467)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/kaltura/intelligent-agents-sdk/compare/v1.37.0...v1.38.0
